# Placeholders

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Deterministic placeholder text for prototyping layouts before real content exists. The sequence is seeded, so repeated renders produce the same document.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`Avatar`](#avatar): A PNG placeholder avatar icon of the requested square size (48 by default), as bytes.
- [`BackgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): A light colour that suits a background fill.
- [`Color`](#color): An accent colour.
- [`CompanyName`](#companyname): A company name.
- [`Currency`](#currency): A currency amount such as `$1,234.50`, between `min` and `max` (1 to 10,000, with `$`, by default).
- [`Decimal`](#decimal): A number between `min` and `max`, rounded to `decimals` places (0 to 1000 with 2 places by default).
- [`Department`](#department): A department name.
- [`Email`](#email): An email address.
- [`Employees`](#employees): Several employee records for directory tables and team prototypes (10 by default).
- [`FirstName`](#firstname): A given name.
- [`Image`](#image): A PNG placeholder image of the requested size, as bytes.
- [`Integer`](#integer): A whole number between `min` and `max` inclusive (0 to 1000 by default).
- [`InvoiceLines`](#invoicelines): Invoice line items, ready for a table (5 by default).
- [`Label`](#label): A two-word capitalised label.
- [`LastName`](#lastname): A family name.
- [`Location`](#location): A place name.
- [`LongDate`](#longdate): A date written out in full.
- [`MonthLabel`](#monthlabel): A month name.
- [`MonthlyValues`](#monthlyvalues): A series of whole numbers for a chart, one per month (12 between 50 and 300 by default).
- [`Name`](#name): A full name.
- [`Paragraph`](#paragraph): A paragraph of lorem-ipsum text.
- [`Paragraphs`](#paragraphs): Several paragraphs of lorem-ipsum text, separated by blank lines (3 by default).
- [`Percent`](#percent): A whole-number percentage such as `42%` (0 to 100 by default).
- [`PhoneNumber`](#phonenumber): A phone number.
- [`Reset`](#reset): Rewinds the shared source to its starting seed (42).
- [`Role`](#role): A job title.
- [`Sentence`](#sentence): One lorem-ipsum sentence.
- [`ShortDate`](#shortdate): A date as `MM/DD/YYYY`.
- [`TableRows`](#tablerows): Rows of table cells (name, department, location, percentage), as arrays of text (5 rows of 4 columns by default).
- [`WithSeed`](#withseed): Returns an independent source that always produces the same sequence for the same seed.
- [`Word`](#word): A single lorem-ipsum word.
